profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Starr Companies

positions.title: Co-Founder, CTO
positions.description:
•	Hands on CTO / Software Architect and Developer. Manage and lead IT department – 3~4 developers, 1 system admin and 3 contractors. Architect, design and develop core business applications including 
•	Manage/mentor developers, lead IT team meetings, code reviews, project planning
o	SmartCRM – ASP.Net 4.0 Web Forms based web application. The company’s main CRM application for sales representatives to manage customer leads data status and activity. It contains number of web based modules such as outbound dialer, inbox manager, auto follow-up manager, schedule to-do manager, inbound call controller, and cross sell controller, one-click emailer, and more small function modules.
o	LeadCast – SQL processing CRM module. It optimizes lead distribution priority for the SmartCRM to maximize contact and conversion ratio. The design concept based on multiple factors such as sales rep individual performance profile, publisher output ratio, current lead volume situation, number of dial attempt, lead type priority, and lead’s originated state time zone.
o	CAP (CARCHEX Administration Portal) – Internal web portal for management, administration, and marketing support utilities for reporting, monitoring, and maintenance. It contains more than 30 utilities and reporting tools. 
o	CARCHEX Direct – MVC Core based public faced web application for customers to allow custom quote creations and modifications also self-checkout by credit card transactions. It also provides access documents.
o	CARCHEX Certified Program – MVC Core based B to B web application for the short-term vehicle protection plan and roadside assistant program. This site provides sales utilities and reports for vehicle dealerships nationwide.
o	CARCHEX API – Web API 2.0 based RESTful API. This application provides majority of APIs for internal and external web applications mostly through JSON format. It creates a complete data logic separation from front end web applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Senior Application Developer, February 2001 – October 2005

•	Worked at CAIS (Customer Analysis & Information Support) as team lead for web based application development team
•	Designed and developed web based document management primarily for the calling plan version control and tracking required by FCC
•	Designed and developed the expanse tracking and reporting application for the mass market group in the marketing division
•	Developed web based reporting system for detail data tracking and search for the Block Buster gift card activation and redemption activities

positions.title: Senior Developer / Contractor
positions.description:
Project Based Contractor, August 2002 – August 2004

•	Worked as project based consultant
•	Designed and developed refinance leads distribution engine for mortgage companies. 
•	Optimized logic to maximize potential output based on service type and cost.  
•	Developed simple user interface to manage lead publisher performance 
•	Supported restructuring real time smart lead delivery engine after the company sold to San Francisco based venture capital.

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
Senior Application Developer, October 1999 – January 2001

•	Worked as a senior developer for the startup company
•	Developed public website for music file (MP3) uploads and downloads for member community 
•	Automated notification email system for subscribed members
•	Design and developed Web based simple chat application

positions.title: Business Owner
positions.description:
Business owner, August 1994 – April 1999

•	System design and solution provider for independent businesses
•	Participate as team lead to provide a document management solution to the Department of Defense in Korea
•	Provide remote business connections through TCP/IP network
•	Developed web based email system based on Linux and Sendmail 
•	Provide websites to businesses
